news.titleEn: Oil Heads for Second Weekly Rise as U.S. Vows to Ramp Up Economic Pressure on Iran
news.conclusionEn: Crude oil climbed toward $94 a barrel and was on track for a second straight weekly gain after President Trump vowed "economic warfare and isolation on an unprecedented scale" against Iran, following Treasury Secretary comments that the U.S. aims to economically collapse the country.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普誓言对伊朗发动「史无前例的经济战」，油价逼近94美元，连续第二周上涨。
news.whyEn: Sustained high oil prices raise input costs for businesses worldwide and add fresh inflation risk just as investors were already worried about elevated Treasury yields, making this a key swing factor for markets in the weeks ahead.
news.whyZh: 油价持续走高会推升全球企业成本、加剧通胀风险，叠加美债收益率高企，成为未来数周左右市场走势的关键变量。
news.detailEn: Trump's latest warning came after Iran rejected what he described as an offer to reach an agreement, prompting him to threaten severe consequences for any country whose banks, businesses or government bodies give Tehran a financial "lifeline." Oil prices, which were up more than 5% for the week, rose further as shipping transits through the Strait of Hormuz stayed unusually low. The threats compounded a rough week for U.S. markets: the Dow suffered its worst single-day drop in three weeks on Thursday as the 30-year Treasury yield pushed above 5.25%, a near two-decade high. Analysts warn that if the standoff escalates further, energy costs could keep upward pressure on inflation heading into the Federal Reserve's September policy meeting.
news.detailZh: 此次警告是在特朗普所称的伊朗拒绝达成协议提议之后发出的，他威胁任何为德黑兰提供资金「生命线」的国家银行、企业或政府部门都将面临严重后果。原油价格本周已上涨逾5%，随着经霍尔木兹海峡的航运量维持在异常低位，价格进一步走高。这一威胁加剧了美股本已艰难的一周：周四道指创三周来最大单日跌幅，30年期美债收益率一度突破5.25%，逼近近二十年高位。分析师警告，若局势进一步升级，能源成本可能在美联储9月议息会议前持续推高通胀压力。

news.titleEn: At Least 14 Killed, Over 100 Wounded in Russian 'Double-Tap' Strike on Ukrainian Shopping Center
news.conclusionEn: Russian drones struck the Solnechnaya Galereya shopping mall in Kryvyi Rih, President Zelenskyy's hometown, on August 21 in a daytime "double-tap" attack that killed at least 14 people and wounded more than 100, including 22 children, according to local officials.
news.conclusionZh: 俄军8月21日「双重打击」乌克兰泽连斯基家乡克里维里赫一处购物中心，至少14人死亡、逾百人受伤，含22名儿童。
news.whyEn: The attack, one of the deadliest civilian strikes in months, escalates pressure on ceasefire efforts and could shape Western debate over further military and financial aid to Ukraine as the war grinds on with no lasting truce in sight.
news.whyZh: 这是数月来最致命的平民袭击之一，将加大停火谈判压力，并可能影响西方对乌克兰军事与财政援助的讨论。
news.detailEn: Local administration head Oleksandr Vilkul said an initial wave of drones struck the mall, followed by a second wave targeting the area as rescue workers responded — a tactic known as a "double-tap" strike. Zelenskyy called the attack a "terrorist act" and vowed Ukraine would respond, while officials warned casualties could rise as jet-powered drones continued circling the city at low altitude, delaying rescue operations. The strike came during an already tense week in which Trump threatened sweeping new economic pressure on Iran, one of Russia's key partners, and as diplomatic efforts to broker a lasting ceasefire remain stalled.
news.detailZh: 克里维里赫市行政负责人维尔库尔表示，首轮无人机袭击购物中心后，第二轮攻击又针对救援人员展开——即所谓「双重打击」战术。泽连斯基称这是「恐怖主义行为」，誓言乌克兰将予以回应；官员警告称，由于喷气动力无人机持续在城市上空低空盘旋，救援受阻，伤亡人数可能进一步上升。此次袭击正值紧张的一周：特朗普威胁对俄罗斯重要伙伴伊朗实施全面经济施压，而斡旋持久停火的外交努力仍陷入僵局。

news.titleEn: S&P 500 Rebounds Friday But Wall Street Books Weekly Losses After Bond Turmoil
news.conclusionEn: U.S. stocks rose on August 21, with the Dow up about 1%, the S&P 500 gaining 0.4% and the Nasdaq adding 0.4%, but all three major indexes still closed the week lower after a bond-market sell-off pushed the 30-year Treasury yield near 5.25%.
news.conclusionZh: 美股8月21日反弹，道指涨约1%，标普500和纳指均涨0.4%，但受债市动荡拖累，三大股指本周仍收跌。
news.whyEn: The divergence between a positive single day and a losing week shows how sensitive equities remain to bond-market swings, and signals investors are still bracing for volatility as they weigh elevated borrowing costs against hopes for future rate cuts.
news.whyZh: 单日反弹与全周下跌并存，说明股市对债市波动依然高度敏感，投资者仍在权衡高企的融资成本与降息预期之间的拉锯。
news.detailEn: Friday's gains offered some relief after a volatile week that saw Walmart post its worst single-day drop in more than four years and long-term Treasury yields spike on concerns about heavy government borrowing. Small-cap stocks in the Russell 2000 outperformed, buoyed by hopes that slowing inflation data could open the door to interest rate cuts later this year. Even so, the weekly declines underscore lingering unease about sticky inflation, elevated oil prices tied to the Iran standoff, and whether the Federal Reserve will have enough room to ease policy without reigniting price pressures.
news.detailZh: 在沃尔玛创四年多来最大单日跌幅、长期美债收益率因政府举债担忧飙升的动荡一周后，周五的反弹带来一丝喘息。罗素2000小盘股表现领先，受通胀数据放缓、市场押注今年稍晚降息的预期提振。尽管如此，全周仍收跌反映出市场对顽固通胀、伊朗局势推高油价，以及美联储能否在不重燃通胀的前提下腾出降息空间仍心存疑虑。

news.titleEn: Alibaba Profit Plunges 76% as AI Capex Surges to $10 Billion in a Quarter
news.conclusionEn: Alibaba's net income fell 76% to 10.54 billion yuan ($1.55 billion) in its fiscal first quarter even as revenue rose 9% to 268.95 billion yuan, after capital expenditure jumped 75% year-over-year to 67.68 billion yuan on AI infrastructure spending.
news.conclusionZh: 阿里巴巴财季净利润暴跌76%至15.5亿美元，营收增9%，因AI基础设施资本开支同比激增75%至约100亿美元。
news.whyEn: As one of China's AI bellwethers, Alibaba's willingness to sacrifice near-term profit for AI capacity signals how intense the AI infrastructure race has become across the industry, and its results will shape investor expectations for other Chinese tech earnings this quarter.
news.whyZh: 作为中国AI风向标，阿里巴巴不惜牺牲短期利润换取AI产能，反映行业AI基础设施竞赛的激烈程度，也将影响本季度其他中国科技股财报的市场预期。
news.detailEn: CEO Eddie Wu said Alibaba expects to break even on its AI-related capital spending within three years based on current gross margins, after already deploying roughly half of its planned 380 billion yuan ($56.4 billion) AI investment for 2026-2029. Cloud revenue growth accelerated on strong enterprise demand for AI computing, but heavy spending on chips and data centers, combined with continued losses in Alibaba's e-commerce and flash-sale businesses, weighed heavily on the bottom line. Alibaba's U.S.-listed shares fell more than 4% in premarket trading on the results, reflecting investor caution about how long the aggressive spending cycle will last.
news.detailZh: 阿里巴巴CEO吴泳铭表示，按当前毛利率水平计算，公司预计在三年内实现AI相关资本开支的收支平衡，目前已投入其2026至2029年规划的3800亿元人民币（约564亿美元）AI投资中的近一半。云业务营收增速在企业AI算力需求强劲拉动下加快，但芯片和数据中心的巨额支出，叠加电商及闪购业务持续亏损，严重拖累了利润表现。财报公布后，阿里巴巴美股盘前一度下跌逾4%，反映投资者对这轮激进投入周期能持续多久仍持谨慎态度。

news.titleEn: Landmark Federal Trial Opens Over Meta's Alleged Harm to Children's Mental Health
news.conclusionEn: A federal trial began this week in California before Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers, with attorneys general from California, Colorado, Kentucky and New Jersey accusing Meta of knowingly designing addictive features that harm children, seeking penalties that could total as much as $1.4 trillion.
news.conclusionZh: 加州联邦法院就Meta涉嫌设计成瘾功能损害儿童心理健康开庭审理，四州总检察长最高索赔达1.4万亿美元。
news.whyEn: A judgment against Meta at this scale could force sweeping changes to how social media platforms are designed for minors worldwide and set a legal precedent that emboldens further state and federal litigation against the industry.
news.whyZh: 若Meta败诉且赔偿规模巨大，可能迫使全球社交平台大幅调整未成年人产品设计，并为其他州及联邦对行业的诉讼树立先例。
news.detailEn: The states allege Meta deliberately built features into Facebook and Instagram designed to maximize youth engagement while hiding known harms from the public, contributing to a wider youth mental health crisis. An eight-person jury is serving in an advisory capacity only, with Judge Rogers set to issue the final ruling. The case follows a March 2026 verdict in a related lawsuit where a jury found Meta's platforms harmful to children and awarded $375 million in damages. Meta has denied the allegations, saying the states offered no proof that anyone was misled and pointing to its existing teen safety protections.
news.detailZh: 四州指控Meta在Facebook和Instagram中刻意设计旨在最大化青少年使用黏性的功能，同时隐瞒已知危害，加剧了青少年心理健康危机。八人陪审团仅担任咨询角色，最终裁决将由罗杰斯法官作出。此案发生在2026年3月一起相关诉讼陪审团裁定Meta平台对儿童有害、判赔3.75亿美元之后。Meta否认相关指控，称各州未能证明有人受到误导，并强调公司已有的青少年安全保护措施。

news.titleEn: U.S. Moves to Close Loophole as Nvidia's Advanced Chips Keep Reaching China
news.conclusionEn: Reports surfaced that Nvidia has been shipping H200 AI chips to major Chinese firms including ByteDance and Tencent, with roughly 10,000 chips going to each, even as Washington reviews and tightens rules meant to restrict advanced chip flows to China.
news.conclusionZh: 据报道英伟达已向字节跳动、腾讯等中国企业各出货约1万颗H200芯片，美方同时正收紧相关出口管控漏洞。
news.whyEn: The tension between actual chip flows and tightening U.S. policy highlights an unresolved fault line in the AI supply chain that affects Nvidia's China revenue, Chinese AI developers' compute access, and the broader trajectory of U.S.-China tech competition.
news.whyZh: 芯片实际流向与美方收紧政策之间的矛盾，凸显AI供应链的一大不确定因素，影响英伟达在华营收、中国AI企业算力获取及中美科技竞争走向。
news.detailEn: The shipments follow a December 2025 policy shift in which Trump allowed Nvidia to sell H200 chips to China, later codified into a formal Commerce Department rule in January 2026. Even so, U.S. officials are now reviewing offshore access channels, including shipments routed through Hong Kong, that may be letting more advanced compute reach mainland China than intended. Nvidia is separately developing a lower-spec, China-specific AI chip that it plans to begin shipping in small volumes by year-end, aiming to maintain a foothold in the Chinese market within whatever restrictions ultimately take effect.
news.detailZh: 此次出货发生在2025年12月特朗普放行英伟达向中国销售H200芯片的政策转向之后，该政策已于2026年1月被美国商务部正式写入规则。尽管如此，美国官员目前正审查包括经香港中转在内的离岸渠道，担忧这些渠道让更多先进算力流入中国大陆，超出预期范围。英伟达另在开发一款规格较低、专供中国市场的AI芯片，计划年底前开始小批量出货，力图在最终生效的限制范围内保住中国市场份额。

news.titleEn: Bitcoin Surges Past $70,000 in Best Week in Two Years as Trump Pushes Crypto Legislation
news.conclusionEn: Bitcoin jumped from about $64,300 on August 19 to nearly $72,000 by August 20, marking its highest level since early June and its best weekly performance in two years, as President Trump pushed Congress to pass the Clarity Act defining crypto regulation.
news.conclusionZh: 比特币从8月19日约6.43万美元飙升至8月20日近7.2万美元，创近两年最佳单周表现，因特朗普推动国会通过加密货币监管法案。
news.whyEn: Regulatory clarity combined with Treasury buyback-driven optimism is drawing fresh institutional flows into crypto, and a sustained rally could pull more retail and corporate treasury capital into digital assets just as traditional markets grapple with bond-market volatility.
news.whyZh: 监管明朗化叠加美债回购带来的乐观情绪正吸引机构资金重新流入加密货币，若涨势持续，可能在传统市场受债市波动困扰之际吸引更多零售和企业资金进入数字资产。
news.detailEn: The rally was fueled by a short squeeze that accelerated after Treasury bond buyback operations eased broader market anxiety and after regulatory optimism emerged from a White House crypto summit. The proposed Clarity Act would settle a long-running debate over whether digital assets should be regulated as securities or commodities, a distinction that has created legal uncertainty for exchanges and token issuers for years. Ethereum also gained alongside Bitcoin. Analysts caution that crypto remains highly sensitive to swings in Treasury yields and risk appetite, meaning the rally could reverse quickly if bond-market turmoil resumes.
news.detailZh: 此轮上涨受空头回补推动而加速，此前美债回购操作缓解了市场整体焦虑，加之白宫加密货币峰会释放监管乐观信号。拟议中的Clarity法案旨在解决数字资产究竟应按证券还是大宗商品监管这一长期争议，该问题多年来一直令交易所和代币发行方面临法律不确定性。以太坊也随比特币同步上涨。分析师提醒，加密货币对美债收益率和风险偏好的波动仍高度敏感，若债市动荡重现，此轮涨势可能迅速逆转。

news.titleEn: China Sentences Evergrande Founder Hui Ka Yan to Life in Prison, Confiscates Fortune
news.conclusionEn: A Shenzhen court sentenced Evergrande founder Hui Ka Yan, once China's richest man, to life in prison on August 20 for fraud and bribery, ordering forfeiture of all his personal assets, with more than 50 associates including his sons also sentenced.
news.conclusionZh: 深圳法院8月20日以欺诈和行贿罪判处恒大创始人许家印无期徒刑并没收全部个人财产，另有超50名关联人员一并获刑。
news.whyEn: The ruling closes a defining chapter of China's property crisis that left over $300 billion in liabilities, and signals Beijing's continued determination to hold former real estate tycoons accountable as it works to stabilize the broader property sector and financial system.
news.whyZh: 该判决为负债超3000亿美元的中国房地产危机标志性篇章画上句号，显示北京在稳定房地产及金融体系过程中持续追究地产大亨责任的决心。
news.detailEn: Hui pleaded guilty in April to eight charges including fundraising fraud, illegally taking public deposits, fraudulently issuing securities and bribery. The Evergrande group was fined 8.82 billion yuan ($1.31 billion) and its real estate unit a further 7 billion yuan ($1.04 billion), while Hui's two sons and senior executives received sentences ranging from 22 months to 18 years. Once the poster child of China's real estate boom, Evergrande collapsed into default in 2021, triggering a broader crisis across the property sector that continues to weigh on China's economy and financial markets today.
news.detailZh: 许家印4月曾就集资诈骗、非法吸收公众存款、欺诈发行证券及行贿等八项罪名认罪。恒大集团被罚款88.2亿元人民币（约13.1亿美元），其地产子公司再被罚70亿元人民币（约10.4亿美元），许家印两名儿子及多名高管被判22个月至18年不等有期徒刑。恒大曾是中国房地产繁荣的标志性企业，2021年爆发债务违约，引发波及整个地产行业的危机，至今仍对中国经济和金融市场造成压力。

businessTips.explanationEn: The sunk cost fallacy is the tendency to keep investing time, money or effort into a decision because of what has already been spent, rather than evaluating whether it still makes sense going forward. Sunk costs are gone regardless of future choices, so rational decisions should weigh only future costs and benefits. Falling into this trap often leads teams to keep funding failing projects long past the point where the evidence says to stop.
businessTips.explanationZh: 沉没成本谬误指人们因为已经投入的时间、金钱或精力，而继续投入某项决策，而不是重新评估这件事未来是否还值得做。已经花掉的成本无法收回，理性决策应只考虑未来的成本和收益。陷入这一误区常导致团队在证据已表明该止损时，仍继续为失败的项目投入资源。
businessTips.exampleEn: A company keeps funding a product that's been in development for two years and losing money each quarter, reasoning "we've already spent so much, we can't stop now." A better approach is to ask: if we were starting today with zero prior investment, would we still choose to fund this project?
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家公司一款已开发两年、每季度持续亏损的产品仍在持续投入，理由是「都投了这么多了，现在不能停」。更好的做法是问自己：如果今天从零开始，我们还会选择投资这个项目吗？

businessTips.explanationEn: Customer Acquisition Cost is the total sales and marketing expense divided by the number of new customers gained over a period. It's one of the most important numbers for a startup or side hustle because it determines whether your growth is actually profitable. CAC only tells the full story when compared against customer lifetime value (LTV) — a low CAC with an even lower LTV can still sink a business.
businessTips.explanationZh: 客户获取成本（CAC）是指某段时期内的销售与营销总支出除以新增客户数量。这是创业或副业最重要的指标之一，因为它决定了增长是否真正带来利润。CAC只有和客户终身价值（LTV）对比时才有完整意义——即使CAC很低，若LTV更低，企业仍可能亏损。
businessTips.exampleEn: A solo founder running paid ads for an online course spends $2,000 in a month and gains 40 new students, giving a CAC of $50 per student. If each student only generates $30 in profit over their lifetime, the business is losing money on every new customer despite feeling like it's growing.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位独立创业者为在线课程投放广告，一个月花费2000美元获得40名新学员，CAC为每人50美元。如果每名学员的终身利润只有30美元，那么即便看起来业务在增长，实际上每获取一位新客户都在亏钱。

businessTips.explanationEn: The P/E ratio divides a company's share price by its earnings per share, giving investors a quick way to gauge how expensive a stock is relative to its profits. A high P/E often means the market expects strong future growth, while a low P/E can signal either an undervalued stock or genuine concerns about the company's prospects. It's most useful when comparing companies within the same industry rather than across different sectors.
businessTips.explanationZh: 市盈率（P/E）是股价除以每股收益，能让投资者快速判断一只股票相对其盈利水平是「贵」还是「便宜」。市盈率高通常意味着市场预期未来强劲增长，市盈率低则可能代表股票被低估，也可能反映市场对公司前景的真实担忧。市盈率在同行业公司间比较时最有参考价值，跨行业比较意义有限。
businessTips.exampleEn: If a stock trades at $100 and earns $5 per share annually, its P/E ratio is 20, meaning investors are paying 20 times the company's current annual earnings for a share. Comparing that 20x P/E against industry peers helps investors judge whether the stock looks expensive or cheap relative to similar businesses.
businessTips.exampleZh: 假设某股票股价为100美元，每股年收益5美元，则市盈率为20倍，意味着投资者为该公司当前年利润支付了20倍的价格。将这一20倍市盈率与同行业公司对比，有助于判断该股票相对同类企业是偏贵还是偏便宜。
